content: New employees should review the first week checklist in the People Portal before their first day. The checklist covers account setup, team introductions, and required training.
Managers schedule a welcome meeting during the employee's first week and introduce the team mentor.
Report a lost or stolen company laptop to the security team immediately, and no later than one hour after discovering it is missing.
Use the device management portal to confirm that disk encryption and automatic screen locking are enabled.
Meals during approved business travel are reimbursed up to 55 dollars per traveler per day. Attach an itemized receipt to the expense report.
Submit expense reports within 30 days of the trip ending. Finance reviews complete reports weekly.
Request planned vacation at least two weeks in advance through the time off system. Your manager must approve the request before travel is booked.
For unexpected illness, notify your manager as soon as practical on the first day away.
If a production service is unavailable, contact the on-call engineer through the incident channel and open a severity assessment.
The service owner posts a written status update every 30 minutes during a major incident.
Archived support tickets are permanently deleted 24 months after closure, unless a legal hold requires longer retention.
Customer attachments are restricted to support staff assigned to the relevant ticket.
